description: Autonomous AI sales development agent — scores leads, calls them, critiques calls, self-improves.

stories.title: FastAPI backend scaffolding
stories.description: Set up FastAPI app with lifespan, CORS, route registration, health and stats endpoints.

stories.title: Pydantic data models
stories.description: Define all request/response models: LeadCreate, LeadScore, CallScores, CallCritique, ScriptImprovement, DashboardStats, VapiWebhookPayload.

stories.title: AI cascade orchestrator
stories.description: Build Gemini → Grok → Claude → OpenAI fallback chain with 24hr LRU cache and JSON parser.

stories.title: AI lead scoring
stories.description: Score inbound leads 0-100 with tier classification using few-shot CoT prompting.

stories.title: 7-category call critique engine
stories.description: Critique every Vapi call across opening, discovery, rapport, objection handling, closing, naturalness, relevance.

stories.title: Autonomous self-improvement loop
stories.description: After 50 calls: summarize patterns → Claude meta-analysis → new prompt → push to Vapi → version history.

stories.title: Vapi outbound call trigger
stories.description: trigger_call() makes POST to Vapi API with assistant ID, phone number, lead metadata, custom variables.

stories.title: Lead ingestion API endpoint
stories.description: POST /api/lead: score → upsert → delayed background call trigger based on tier.

stories.title: Vapi webhook handler
stories.description: POST /webhooks/vapi: handle end-of-call-report, critique, store call, update lead status, queue improvements, auto-trigger at 50-call threshold.

stories.title: Supabase database layer
stories.description: All DB operations: leads CRUD, calls insert/query, improvements queue, prompt versions, audit log.

stories.title: Supabase schema
stories.description: Full PostgreSQL schema: leads, calls, agent_improvements, prompt_versions, audit_log, daily_stats. Seeded with v1 Vapi prompt.

stories.title: Streamlit command center dashboard
stories.description: 5-page dark-themed dashboard: Overview KPIs, Lead Pipeline, Call Center, Agent Brain, Settings. Plotly charts.

stories.title: Next.js landing page
stories.description: Lead capture form that POSTs to backend, shows real-time score/tier on submission.

stories.title: Docker Compose orchestration
stories.description: docker-compose.yml wiring up backend, dashboard, landing services.

stories.title: Complete test suite
stories.description: pytest tests covering leads, webhooks, scoring, improvement loop, health endpoint.
